thread.title: Dow Jones Leads Stock Market Action; Nike Stock Regains Entry

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones Leads Stock Market Action; Nike Stock Regains Entry

organizations.name: dow jones leads stock market action

text:
The Dow Jones industrial average led in mixed stock market action early Monday. Top retailer and Dow stock Nike ( NKE ) is breaking out back above a potential buy point, according to MarketSmith chart analysis. Meanwhile, electric automaker Tesla ( TSLA ) skidded another 2% on a price-target slash. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X The Dow Jones industrial average moved up 0.5%, while the S&P 500 added 0.2% in morning trade. The tech-heavy Nasdaq edged lower.
Among the Dow stocks , Nike ( NKE ) was one of the top-performing names with a more-than-2% gain. The stock regained its 81.10 flat-base entry. Nike stock saw several upgrades early Monday. Piper Jaffray upgraded the stock from neutral to overweight, while Susquehanna Financial raised it from neutral to positive. Susquehanna raised its price target from 78 to 93.
Meanwhile, Leaderboard stock Apple ( AAPL ) hit another record high before reversing lower. Shares are up about 12% from a flat base's 194.30 buy point.

JPMorgan cut its price target on the electric automaker from 308 to 195 — a near-37% reduction. The analyst commented that the process of going private is less developed than earlier presumed.
The stock broke out past a cup-shaped base's 373.83 entry on Aug. 7 when CEO Elon Musk tweeted saying he was considering taking the company private. Days later, the stock triggered the 7%-8% loss-cutting sell rule amid mounting concerns of the company's ability to go private. Shares are now about 22% off the 387.46 high price set on Aug. 7.
F5 Networks ( FFIV ) is nearing a flat base's 183.37 buy point Monday. Shares rose over 1% to 183.00 in morning trade. The stock boasts a 93 out of a highest-possible 99 IBD Composite Rating.
Inside The IBD 50 Among the top growth stocks , teen-centric retailer Five Below ( FIVE ) hit a new high with a 1% advance. Shares have gained more than 40% from a 78.38 flat-base entry after a breakout in early June.
